## Walkthrough

A new GitHub Actions workflow file configures daily and on-demand fuzzing for the vinwolf target. The workflow reuses a shared fuzz-source template, supplying vinwolf-specific parameters including target name, Docker image, and matrix-driven spec variations with corresponding block counts.

## Changes

**Vinwolf Fuzz Workflow**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Vinwolf fuzz workflow configuration** <br> `.github/workflows/vinwolf-fuzz.yml` | Event triggers (daily cron, manual dispatch, self-modified), minimal permissions (`contents: read`, `issues: write`), and a parameterized job that reuses the shared fuzz-source workflow with vinwolf-specific inputs (`target_name`, Docker image, `tiny`/`full` specs with corresponding block counts, `timeout_minutes: 1380`, `num_runs: 10`, `mention: bloppan`). |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~8 minutes
